description: Detect and integrate peaks: chromatograms (detector traces, TIC, XIC, SRM) with retention time, area, height, widths, tailing, plates, resolution, S/N and area % (purity); one peak near rt; a compound list; bands and regions of IR, Raman, UV-Vis and NMR spectra and peaks of sized electropherograms in bp (x_range, integrate). Takes the openreadout_chromatogram arguments to choose the signal.

Compound.description: One compound of a targeted method.

mz.description: XIC m/z (with `precursor_mz`: a product ion in MS/MS scans).

polarity.description: Scan polarity. `positive` = Positive-ion scans; `negative` = Negative-ion scans.

precursor_mz.description: Precursor m/z of the MS/MS scans (product-ion XIC).

rt_min.description: Expected retention time, minutes (absent: the largest peak of the chromatogram).

rt_window_min.description: Half-width of the retention-time window, minutes.

trace.description: Detector trace index (for UV, FID, … quantitation).

aggregate.description: `sum` (default) or `max` of the points inside an XIC window.

area_seconds.description: Areas in signal × seconds instead of signal × minutes. Default false.

baseline.description: Baseline under detected peaks: `auto` (default), `drop`, `valley` or `tangent`; or the baseline under `x_range` windows and manual integrations: `linear` (default: a straight line between the window's ends) or `none` (area of the signal itself).

channel.description: Channel of the traces (e.g. one DAD wavelength). Default: the first signal channel.

compounds.description: Targeted compounds: `[{name, mz? | q1+q3? | trace?, rt?, window?, ppm?, polarity?, ms_level?, precursor?}]`; one result row each under `compounds`.

da.description: XIC tolerance in m/z units instead of ppm.

file.description: Path to the file or data-set directory.

min_snr.description: Detection threshold, height / noise σ. Default 3.

min_width.description: Smallest width at half height, minutes.

ms_level.description: MS level of the scans. Default 1 (2 with `precursor`).

mz.description: Extracted-ion chromatograms at these m/z values (one streaming pass for all).

mz_range.description: TIC/BPC over this m/z range only, `[low, high]`.

polarity.description: `positive` or `negative`: only scans of this polarity.

precursor.description: Only MS/MS scans of this precursor m/z (product-ion XIC).

profile.description: Use profile data where scans store both profile and centroids. Default false (the instrument's centroids).

rt.description: Expected retention time (minutes): also report the peak there as `picked`.

scan_filter.description: Only scans whose scan filter/description contains this text (case-insensitive).

smooth.description: Savitzky–Golay window in points (below 5: none). Default automatic.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

summary_only.description: Leave out the full peak tables (keep compounds, picked and manual results). Default false.

sweep.description: Sweep of the traces (one spectrum of a map or series, one injection). Default 0.

tic.description: Total-ion chromatogram (the default for mass-spectrometry files when nothing else is chosen).

traces.description: Stored chromatograms or detector signals (UV/DAD, FID, TCD, stored TIC/SRM): trace indices from openreadout_info → traces[].

transition_tol.description: Q1/Q3 tolerance of transitions, m/z units. Default 0.5.

window.description: Half-width of the `rt` window (and of compounds without one), minutes. Default 0.5.

x_range.description: Axis windows `[[a, b], ...]` to integrate, in the axis's own units (either order): on a spectrum (IR/Raman cm⁻¹, UV nm, NMR ppm) each is a region under `spectra[].regions` (area with the `baseline`, area without it, maximum, centroid, the bands inside); on a chromatogram a manual integration in minutes.

name: openreadout_peaks

area.description: Area above the baseline (below it when bands are minima), signal units × axis units.

area_percent.description: Share of the summed area of all bands of the spectrum, %.

baseline_code.description: How each end meets the baseline (as `analyze peaks`: `B`, `V`, `T`).

baseline_end.description: Baseline at the end, signal units.

baseline_reason.description: `auto` baseline: why the baseline was drawn this way (as `analyze peaks`).

baseline_start.description: Baseline at the start, signal units.

height.description: Height above the baseline (depth below it when bands are minima), signal units.

number.description: 1-based band number in order of increasing x.

width_half.description: Full width at half height, axis units.

x.description:
Apex position (vertex of the parabola through the three highest smoothed points), axis
units.

min_width.description: Smallest width at half height, axis units.

CompoundResult.description: One result row: a compound in one file.

area_percent.description: Area % of the peak within its chromatogram.

chromatogram.description: Label of the chromatogram it was measured on.

found.description: True when a peak was found in the window.

note.description: Why nothing was found, or anything else worth knowing.

Peak.description: One integrated peak (a flat record: one row of a peak table).

area.description: Area above the baseline between start and end, signal units × `area_time_unit`.

area_percent.description: Share of the summed area of all peaks in the table, %.

asymmetry_factor.description: Asymmetry factor `b/a` at 10 % height (a: leading half-width, b: trailing half-width).

baseline_code.description:
How each end meets the baseline: `B` baseline, `V` valley (drop line), `T` tangent skim,
`M` manual (given boundaries); e.g. `BB`, `BV`, `VB`, `TT`.

baseline_end.description: Baseline value at the end, signal units.

baseline_reason.description:
`auto` baseline: why the baseline was drawn this way — `sloped_background` (an end was
placed where the peak meets a sloped or drifting background), `drop_line` (fused with a
neighbour: common baseline, vertical drop line at the valley), `baseline_penetration`
(split from a neighbour where the signal dips below their common baseline), `isolated`
(both ends on the baseline). The first that applies.

baseline_start.description: Baseline value at the start, signal units.

height.description: Height of the apex above the baseline, signal units.

plates.description: Theoretical plates, half-height method `5.54 (t_R / W½)²` (t_R from time zero).

resolution.description: Resolution to the previous peak, `1.18 (t₂ − t₁) / (W½₁ + W½₂)`.

rt_min.description: Retention time of the apex, minutes.

snr.description: Height / noise σ (absent when the noise is 0).

tailing_factor.description: USP tailing factor `W₀.₀₅ / 2f` (f: apex to the leading edge at 5 % height).

width_half_min.description:
Width at half height, minutes (absent when the signal does not fall to half height
before a drop line).

PeakMethod.description: The method that produced a peak table, with every parameter actually used.

baseline_window_points.description: Window of the running baseline, points.

characteristic_width_points.description:
Median width at half height of the most prominent maxima, points (drives the automatic
smoothing and baseline windows).

look_ahead_points.description: `auto`: how far a flat stretch must go on without a valley to end a peak, points.

min_width_min.description: Smallest width at half height, minutes.

slope_noise.description:
`auto`: noise of the smoothed signal's derivative, signal units per minute (flanks end
below [`AUTO_END_SLOPE_NOISE`] times it).

smooth_auto.description: True when the window was chosen automatically.

PickedPeak.description: The expected peak of a chromatogram (`--rt`/`--window`).

peak.description: The peak, when one has its apex in the window.

Region.description: One integrated region of a spectrum.

area.description: Trapezoidal integral of (signal − baseline), signal units × axis units.

area_no_baseline.description: Trapezoidal integral of the signal itself.

centroid.description: (signal − baseline)-weighted mean axis value (absent when that integral is not positive).

from.description: Lower end asked for, axis units.

max_height.description: Height of the maximum above the baseline (depth below it when bands are minima).

max_x.description:
Axis value of the region maximum (the sample of largest signal − baseline; of largest
baseline − signal when bands are minima).

peaks.description: Numbers of the detected bands whose apex lies in the region.

peaks_area.description: Summed area of those bands (each above its own detection baseline).

to.description: Upper end asked for, axis units.

x_first.description: Axis value of the first sample used.

x_last.description: Axis value of the last sample used.

SpectrumBands.description: Bands and regions of one spectrum.

area_unit.description: Unit of areas: signal unit (or quantity) × axis unit.

bands_are_minima.description: Bands are minima (transmittance, reflectance): detected on the negated signal.

peaks.description: Detected bands (with regions: only those with the apex in one), in order of x.

compounds.description: One row per compound of the compound list.

format.description: Format id of the input file.

spectra.description:
Spectra (traces whose axis is not time: wavenumber, wavelength, ppm, …): bands and
integrated regions, one entry per analysed spectrum.
